thread_text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy INITIATED for service `inference-runtime` environment=staging commit=fa7c9d2 tag=v1.8.0-canary-001

deploy-bot: steps=build->push->k8s-rollout target=10% traffic; health-checks=latency(95p)<120ms,error-rate<0.5%

samantha: copying logs to #eng-sre, watching dd dashboard https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/xyz-inference-canary ; will alert if cpu spike >85% or p95>300ms

kevin: running quick smoke now — hitting /v1/generate 50 reqs across 3 models. first pass looks okay, kv-cache warming as expected :thumbsup:

lucy: note for release notes: pinned model variant -> `redwood/gpt-small-quant:v2` for canary. will include in changelog that production will use the same artifact unless rollback required

priya: tagging PM/ops: feature flags unchanged, no schema changes. window is a 2h change window (20:00-22:00 UTC).

samantha: small error burst at +2m: 12/500 errors 502 from pod inference-rt-2. investigating logs (possible cold-start on quant kernels)

kevin: grabbing pod logs: ```
ERROR inference-rt: timeout waiting for kvcache init
stack: com.redwood.inference.RuntimeTimeout
```

deploy-bot: Canary traffic scaled DOWN to 5% while team investigates (automated safety policy)

samantha: rolled a restart on inference-rt-2, rebalanced pods. retesting now at 10 targeted requests

kevin: after restart, no 502s for 1m; p95 stable ~110ms. opting to continue. no rollback planned.

deploy-bot: Canary health ok -> reached 10% steady for 10m, automated check PASSED. promoting to 50% traffic (step-up).

lucy: reminder: we pinned model on canary, but not on stable yet. if 50% looks good, we'll promote tag v1.8.0 to `stable` and start prod canary per rollout playbook.

dave: small note — autoscaler observed slight pod churn; increasing targetReplicas from 4->6 in the canary RC to smooth latency.

priya: from product side, QA ran prompt regression suite on canary variant: 0 regressions flagged. thumbs up to promote.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion: traffic=50% -> Promotion decision: APPROVE by automation and manual consent. preparing stable-tag `v1.8.0` for dedicated rollout.

lucy: proceeding with tag promotion. final checklist: docs updated, release notes drafted, oncall standby. I'll open the release PR and notify postmortem channel if anything odd.

deploy-bot: ACTION: tag created -> `v1.8.0` (ref fa7c9d2). Scheduled prod canary at 2024-11-08T20:10:00Z (change window).

kevin: left a quick note in Jira INF-412: rollback plan validated (pin older model artifact + scale down canary).

samantha: closing thread for now — will re-open if alerts trigger during prod canary. great run everyone :tada:
